title: SafePath Hazard Detection Failure Case & Error Analysis

documented_failure_cases.symptom: Shadow patches on sunny roads falsely detected as potholes (False Positive).
documented_failure_cases.root_cause: High-contrast edge gradients and low intensity look statistically similar to asphalt cavity depressions in RGB color space.
documented_failure_cases.mitigation: Multi-frame persistence verification (living hazard map DBSCAN merge) and shadow invariant color spaces or depth cues.

documented_failure_cases.symptom: Unmarked speed breakers and dark animals missed in headlight periphery (False Negative).
documented_failure_cases.root_cause: Low signal-to-noise ratio and high ISO sensor noise in unlit Indian suburban stretches.
documented_failure_cases.mitigation: Brightness-based lighting estimator (Module 1) integrates with fuzzy safety engine (Module 3) to raise caution score when road is unlit.

documented_failure_cases.symptom: Water reflections and puddle mirror effects confuse bounding box boundaries.
documented_failure_cases.root_cause: Specular reflection from wet pavement obscures pothole depth contour and creates illusory edge textures.
documented_failure_cases.observed_frequency: Moderate (12% drop in mAP during rain/monsoon simulations)
documented_failure_cases.mitigation: Data augmentation using specular glare transforms during fine-tuning.

documented_failure_cases.symptom: Fast vehicle travel over rough roads causes horizontal blur, resulting in missed small potholes.
documented_failure_cases.root_cause: Dashcam exposure times exceed 1/200s in dim environments combined with vehicle suspension vibration.
documented_failure_cases.mitigation: 1-2s interval sampling combined with Laplacian blur variance rejection.

documented_failure_cases.symptom: Dark animals (e.g., buffalo or dark stray dogs) sleeping in median or dark asphalt.
documented_failure_cases.root_cause: Foreground-background luminance similarity against bitumen pavement.
documented_failure_cases.observed_frequency: Significant safety hazard on Indian intercity roads
documented_failure_cases.mitigation: Pre-trained COCO mammal weights combined with spatial proximity warning.

summary: Indian road scenes present unique optical challenges including heavy canopy shadows, monsoon puddle glares, and dark stray animals. While YOLOv8-nano significantly outperforms the baseline, perception errors are handled upstream by SafePath's multi-drive living hazard map and fuzzy safety engine.
